name: WittyRigs
summary: Gaming PCs running Sunshine as games libraries, and the advanced option of hosting demanding PC games on your server's own hardware.
updates: All of it: game rigs (adding, pairing, their games and playing them), this server's own Sunshine, the in-page stream of a rig's game, and their screens on every app.
stays: A rig's games library and its games stay ordinary libraries and items of the server's, so every access rule applies to them.
